note: The equiconsistency problem emerged from Solovay's work in the late 1960s when he defined supercompact cardinals and initially conjectured that every strongly compact cardinal is supercompact. This conjecture was refuted by Menas in the early 1970s. The exact year the consistency problem was first posed is not explicitly stated in available sources. The problem is now described as the 'holy grail' of inner model theory.
